**[P1] Reject hosts that cannot advertise the local carrier**

This fallback still accepts `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID` when `InvocationInfo` lacks the property, while this OTel release supports core 2.4–2.6/API v1 and OTel-only layers where the property can never be forwarded. On Managed Instances, those supported combinations can therefore attach spans to another invocation's stale process header. Require core 2.7+ and enforce it for dynamic layer loading via a provider/capability handshake, or add an explicit host capability and fail closed when it is absent.
